fields.definition: ArgentSea's immutable value type implementing the virtual compound key. It combines a `short` `ShardId` (`0` = empty) with one to four key components (`RecordId`, `ChildId`, `GrandChildId`, `GreatGrandChildId`): `ShardKey<TRecord>`, `ShardKey<TRecord, TChild>`, `ShardKey<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild>`, and `ShardKey<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild, TGreatGrandChild>`. It embeds `ShardKeyTypeMetadata` in binary, UTF-8, and external string representations, while value equality compares only `ShardId` and the key component values.
fields.name: ShardKey
